ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: First, inspect the fixture base plate for cracks or surface distortion. Second, check locating surfaces, dowel holes, and mounting pad faces for damage. Third, inspect each clamp body for deformation or cracked pivot pins.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the fixture base plate for cracks or surface distortion. 2. Check locating surfaces, dowel holes, and mounting pad faces for damage. 3. Inspect each clamp body for deformation or cracked pivot pins.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've completed all three checks. The base plate looks good with no cracks or distortion, locating surfaces and dowel holes are undamaged, and all clamp bodies are intact.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the fixture base plate for cracks or surface distortion. 2. Check locating surfaces, dowel holes, and mounting pad faces for damage. 3. Inspect each clamp body for deformation or cracked pivot pins.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there any base plate cracks, distortion, or damaged mounting surfaces?

ground_truth.node_text: Base plate cracks, distortion or damaged mounting surfaces?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, everything is in good condition with no visible damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Base plate cracks, distortion or damaged mounting surfaces?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the datum A surface within flatness tolerance of 0.02 millimeters?

ground_truth.node_text: Datum A surface within flatness tolerance of 0.02 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the flatness measurement shows it's outside the tolerance limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Datum A surface within flatness tolerance of 0.02 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Scrape or regrind the datum A surface to restore flatness.

ground_truth.node_text: Scrape or regrind datum A surface to restore flatness

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've reground the datum A surface and it's now restored to proper flatness.

ground_truth.node_text: Scrape or regrind datum A surface to restore flatness

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Locate the probe stylus against the primary locating pin at three heights along the pin axis. Record the pin position in X and Y relative to the fixture datum origin and compare against the nominal position on the fixture design drawing.

ground_truth.node_text: Locate the probe stylus against the primary locating pin at three heights along the pin axis. Record the pin position in X and Y relative to the fixture datum origin. Compare the measured position against the nominal position on the fixture design drawing; deviation greater than the tolerance stated in the process control plan requires fixture withdrawal for repair.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've probed the primary locating pin at three heights and recorded the X and Y positions. The measurements are documented.

ground_truth.node_text: Locate the probe stylus against the primary locating pin at three heights along the pin axis. Record the pin position in X and Y relative to the fixture datum origin. Compare the measured position against the nominal position on the fixture design drawing; deviation greater than the tolerance stated in the process control plan requires fixture withdrawal for repair.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the primary locating pins within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of nominal position?

ground_truth.node_text: Primary locating pins within ±0.01 mm of nominal position?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all measurements fall within the tolerance band.

ground_truth.node_text: Primary locating pins within ±0.01 mm of nominal position?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the secondary locating pins within plus or minus 0.015 millimeters of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary locating pins within ±0.015 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the secondary pin is reading outside the tolerance range.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary locating pins within ±0.015 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following steps: Identify the secondary locating pin bore that is out of position, loosen the bore insert retention screws and use an adjusting tool to shift the bore, then retorque the retention screws and remeasure the bore position.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Identify the secondary locating pin bore that is out of position. 2. Loosen the bore insert retention screws and use an adjusting tool to shift the bore. 3. Retorque the retention screws and remeasure the bore position.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've adjusted the secondary pin bore, retorqued the screws, and remeasured. The position has been corrected.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Identify the secondary locating pin bore that is out of position. 2. Loosen the bore insert retention screws and use an adjusting tool to shift the bore. 3. Retorque the retention screws and remeasure the bore position.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Using a calibrated height gauge on the machine table surface plate, measure the height of each of the four reference pads relative to the fixture base. Record all four values and calculate the height variation.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a calibrated height gauge on the machine table surface plate, measure the height of each of the four reference pads relative to the fixture base. Record all four values and calculate the height variation. A variation exceeding the flatness tolerance on the fixture drawing indicates that one or more pads has been contaminated, damaged, or that the fixture base has distorted.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've measured all four reference pad heights and calculated the variation between them.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a calibrated height gauge on the machine table surface plate, measure the height of each of the four reference pads relative to the fixture base. Record all four values and calculate the height variation. A variation exceeding the flatness tolerance on the fixture drawing indicates that one or more pads has been contaminated, damaged, or that the fixture base has distorted.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all Z height reference pads within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of each other?

ground_truth.node_text: All Z height reference pads within ±0.01 mm of each other?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, one of the pads is showing a height difference beyond the tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: All Z height reference pads within ±0.01 mm of each other?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Regrind or shim the low reference pads to restore coplanarity.

ground_truth.node_text: Regrind or shim low reference pads to restore coplanarity

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've shimmed the low pad and verified that coplanarity is restored.

ground_truth.node_text: Regrind or shim low reference pads to restore coplanarity

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Place a precision spirit level on the angular datum face and record the displayed deviation from level. Set up a sine bar at the nominal fixture angle and verify the angular datum contacts the sine bar face flush with no rocking.

ground_truth.node_text: Place a precision spirit level on the angular datum face and record the displayed deviation from level. Set up a sine bar at the nominal fixture angle and verify the angular datum contacts the sine bar face flush with no rocking. Record the angular deviation and compare against the angular tolerance in the fixture specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've checked the angular datum with both the spirit level and sine bar. The readings are recorded and the contact is flush.

ground_truth.node_text: Place a precision spirit level on the angular datum face and record the displayed deviation from level. Set up a sine bar at the nominal fixture angle and verify the angular datum contacts the sine bar face flush with no rocking. Record the angular deviation and compare against the angular tolerance in the fixture specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the angular datum within 0.005 millimeters per 100 millimeters tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Angular datum within 0.005 mm per 100 mm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the angular deviation is well within the specified tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Angular datum within 0.005 mm per 100 mm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all clamping forces within plus or minus 8 percent of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: All clamping forces within ±8% of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, I've checked each clamp station and all forces are within the acceptable range.

ground_truth.node_text: All clamping forces within ±8% of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal expansion datum shift within model prediction plus or minus 0.01 millimeters?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal expansion datum shift within model prediction ±0.01 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measured thermal shift exceeds the predicted range.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal expansion datum shift within model prediction ±0.01 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following steps: Read the thermal compensation model coefficients from the controller, compare the stored values against the reference calibration record, and check the guide rail straightness against the 0.01 millimeter per 300 millimeter limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Read the thermal compensation model coefficients from the controller. 2. Compare the stored values against the reference calibration record. 3. Check the guide rail straightness and compare against the 0.01 mm per 300 mm limit.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've verified the thermal compensation coefficients and checked the guide rail straightness as instructed.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Read the thermal compensation model coefficients from the controller. 2. Compare the stored values against the reference calibration record. 3. Check the guide rail straightness and compare against the 0.01 mm per 300 mm limit.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Slide a precision straight edge along the full length of each guide rail and use feeler gauges to measure any gap between the straight edge and the rail surface. Record the maximum gap at any point and inspect the rail surface under a magnifier.

ground_truth.node_text: Slide a precision straight edge along the full length of each guide rail and use feeler gauges to measure any gap between the straight edge and the rail surface. Record the maximum gap at any point. Inspect the rail surface under a magnifier for pitting, fretting, or embedded swarf; any surface defect in the running zone requires assessment against the surface finish specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've completed the straightness measurement on all guide rails and inspected the surfaces. Maximum gaps are recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Slide a precision straight edge along the full length of each guide rail and use feeler gauges to measure any gap between the straight edge and the rail surface. Record the maximum gap at any point. Inspect the rail surface under a magnifier for pitting, fretting, or embedded swarf; any surface defect in the running zone requires assessment against the surface finish specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the guide rail straightness within 0.01 millimeters per 300 millimeters?

ground_truth.node_text: Guide rail straightness within 0.01 mm per 300 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all guide rails meet the straightness specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Guide rail straightness within 0.01 mm per 300 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Have all lubrication points been serviced per schedule?

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per schedule?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, I've serviced every lubrication point according to the maintenance schedule.

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per schedule?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the reference part positioned within plus or minus 0.02 millimeters of nominal at all datums?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part positioned within ±0.02 mm of nominal at all datums?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all datum measurements on the reference part are within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part positioned within ±0.02 mm of nominal at all datums?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the coordinate measuring machine data, clamp forces, and service details.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coordinate measuring machine data, clamp forces and service details

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've logged all CMM data, clamp force readings, and service details in the maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coordinate measuring machine data, clamp forces and service details

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The fixture has passed all diagnostic checks and is cleared for production use.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
